items.title: Independent study on the impact of age assurance on fundamental rights and costs for businesses
items.description: Independent study on the impact of age assurance on fundamental rights and costs for businesses Anonymous (not verified) Wed, 11/04/2026 - 15:04 An independent study analyses the impacts of age assurance on fundamental rights and the costs for businesses concerned. Age assurance is key for a safer online environment as it ensures that children only access online services and features that are safe and age appropriate for them. Nowadays, 1 in 3 children, aged 9 to 11 across 6 European countries, reports having a social media profile. Very few services are implementing age assurance in a systematic way. items.title: Call for evidence on advertising repositories
items.description: Call for evidence on advertising repositories Anonymous (not verified) Wed, 11/04/2026 - 11:10 Opening: 04 November 2026 Closing: 02 December 2026 The Commission is seeking feedback on upcoming technical guidelines concerning advertising repositories under the Digital Services Act (DSA). The feedback is being gathered through a call for evidence . The responses collected through the call for evidence will help shape guidelines aimed at ensuring that advertising repositories meet the needs of their users.
